import.hint: In rekordbox, right-click a list under History and choose “Export a playlist to a file”. Each file becomes one set.
import.done_one: Imported {{count, number}} play, {{matched, number}} of them in your music.
import.done_other: Imported {{count, number}} plays, {{matched, number}} of them in your music.
import.skippedLines_one: {{count, number}} line couldn't be read and was skipped.
import.skippedLines_other: {{count, number}} lines couldn't be read and were skipped.

refusal.fileTooBig: That file is too big for a playlist (over 5 MB).
refusal.alreadyImported: This set is already imported: the same tracks in the same order.

sessions.label: Sets
sessions.none: No sets yet. Import an m3u8 file from rekordbox's History.
sessions.summary_one: {{date}} · {{count, number}} play, {{matched, number}} in your music
sessions.summary_other: {{date}} · {{count, number}} plays, {{matched, number}} in your music

plays.label: Plays
plays.choose: Choose a set to see its plays.

wishlist.label: Wishlist
wishlist.add: Add the tracks you don't have to this wishlist
wishlist.noLists: Make a wishlist first to add the tracks you don't have.
wishlist.added_one: {{count, number}} track added to the wishlist.
wishlist.added_other: {{count, number}} tracks added to the wishlist.
wishlist.skipped_one: {{count, number}} track was left out: the file gives it no artist and title.
wishlist.skipped_other: {{count, number}} tracks were left out: the file gives them no artist and title.

stick.label: Import from a gig stick
stick.hint: Close rekordbox before reading a gig stick: it rewrites the stick's database as soon as the stick is plugged in. Choose the stick's top folder. The stick is only read.
stick.noLists: This stick has no history lists.
stick.done_one: Imported {{count, number}} set from the stick.
stick.done_other: Imported {{count, number}} sets from the stick.
stick.unmatched_one: {{count, number}} play isn't in your music. It's kept with its artist and title.
stick.unmatched_other: {{count, number}} plays aren't in your music. They're kept with their artist and title.
stick.alreadyImported_one: {{count, number}} list was already imported on that date and was left out.
stick.alreadyImported_other: {{count, number}} lists were already imported on that date and were left out.
stick.skipped_one: {{count, number}} part of the stick's database couldn't be read and was skipped.
stick.skipped_other: {{count, number}} parts of the stick's database couldn't be read and were skipped.
stick.plays_one: Imported {{count, number}} play, {{matched, number}} of them the same audio as a track in your music.
stick.plays_other: Imported {{count, number}} plays, {{matched, number}} of them the same audio as a track in your music.
stick.ambiguous_one: {{count, number}} play has the same audio as more than one track in your music, so it wasn't matched.
stick.ambiguous_other: {{count, number}} plays have the same audio as more than one track in your music, so they weren't matched.
stick.unreadableFiles_one: {{count, number}} play's file on the stick couldn't be read, so it wasn't matched.
stick.unreadableFiles_other: {{count, number}} plays' files on the stick couldn't be read, so they weren't matched.

refusal.noExport: That folder has no rekordbox export (PIONEER\rekordbox\export.pdb). Choose the stick's top folder.
refusal.tooBig: The stick's database is too big to read (over 256 MB).
refusal.notAnExport: The stick's database isn't one rekordbox wrote, or it's damaged.
refusal.nothingChosen: Tick at least one list with plays.
